questionSnapshot.question: What is the name of the famous mouse character Walt Disney created?

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Challenged attribution rather than merely mouse identity: all four are mice, but the alternative creators are White, Cosgrove/Hall and Hanna/Barbera. No TV-show facts are being tested.

verification.context: What is the name of the famous mouse character Walt Disney created?

premise.reason: Disney's primary mouse character; Walt and Ub Iwerks collaborated on his creation.
